subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should this PR require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before maintainers accept the one-tick defer as the fix for the missing-tool-result race?
rationale: The code path and focused tests line up with the reported race, but the user-visible failure is a production channel/session-state issue and the submitted proof still does not exercise that path.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept focused source proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on the shared-helper diff and regression tests while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind the open Feishu/broad race reports until someone can produce live or production-runner evidence.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The session guard and synthetic pending-result behavior are central to the proof-sufficiency choice.
